Write the general term $T_{r+1}$ in the binomial expansion of $(2 + ax)^7$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r}2^{7-r}(ax)^r = \binom{7}{r}2^{7-r}a^r x^r$$

Extract the terms in $x$ (for $r = 1$) and $x^2$ (for $r = 2$):
$$\text{Term in } x = \binom{7}{1}2^6 a x = 7(64)a x = 448a x$$
$$\text{Term in } x^2 = \binom{7}{2}2^5 a^2 x^2 = 21(32)a^2 x^2 = 672a^2 x^2$$

Equate the two coefficients and solve for $a \ne 0$:
$$448a = 672a^2 \implies 672a = 448 \implies a = \frac{448}{672} = \frac{2}{3} \quad (\approx 0.667)$$
